explication: Peekaboo is a macOS automation product with a CLI, menu-bar app, agent, and MCP interface. Its central loop is to observe a screen or app, inspect structured UI state, then perform targeted actions and report results. The graph preserves the documented capture, interaction, system-control, agent, MCP/browser, and desktop-app capabilities. Some subsystem links are dashed because their implementation was not sampled; README statements establish the user-facing capabilities, not all internal call paths.
